*   **Orientation Flip Threshold:** The dot product threshold is 0.
*   **Incorrect Normal Orientation:** If normals are not consistently oriented relative to the camera, the alpha-composited result will be noisy or incorrect.
*   **Degenerate Gaussians:** If a Gaussian becomes extremely flat or its scale collapses, the "shortest axis" direction may become unstable.
*   **Depth Sorting:** The accuracy of the normal estimation depends on the correct front-to-back sorting of Gaussians, as in standard 3D Gaussian Splatting [Parent].
